house.description: Cap on reasonable attorney fees and punitive damages for certain actions in places of public accommodation alleging discrimination.

House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

latest_action.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Judiciary Finance and Civil Law

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to civil actions; removing cap on reasonable attorney fees and punitive damages for certain actions in places of public accommodation alleging discrimination; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 604.12, subdivision 3.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 604.12, subdivision 3, is amended to read:

Subd. 3.
Civil cause of action.
A person injured by a violation of subdivision 2 may bring an action for actual damages, punitive damages under sections 549.191 and 549.20 [-in an amount not to exceed $500-], injunctive relief, and reasonable attorney fees [-in an amount not to exceed $500-].
